message.content:
Make one targeted fix to the Dockerfile at `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/churn-renewal-forecast/Dockerfile`.

The runner stage currently copies `src/lib` but is missing `src/types`. Since `src/lib/utils.ts` imports from `@/types`, the worker could fail at runtime when it transitively hits that import. Add `src/types` to the runner COPY block.

Find this section in the Dockerfile:
```dockerfile
# Worker TypeScript source and shared lib (Bun runs .ts natively)
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/worker ./src/worker
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/lib ./src/lib
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/generated ./src/generated
```

Change it to:
```dockerfile
# Worker TypeScript source and shared lib (Bun runs .ts natively)
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/worker ./src/worker
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/lib ./src/lib
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/types ./src/types
COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/generated ./src/generated
```

Then amend the HEAD commit (the Dockerfile commit):
```bash
git add Dockerfile
git commit --amend --no-edit
```

That is the only change. Nothing else.

Report: Status + confirm the line was added and commit amended.

1	# Stage 1: production-only dependencies
2	FROM oven/bun:1-slim AS deps
3	WORKDIR /app
4	
5	COPY package.json bun.lock .npmrc ./
6	COPY prisma ./prisma
7	
8	# --ignore-scripts skips postinstall (prisma generate) — prisma CLI is not
9	# available in a production install; the generated client comes from the build stage.
10	RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --production --ignore-scripts
11	
12	# Stage 2: full install, prisma generate, next build
13	FROM oven/bun:1-slim AS build
14	WORKDIR /app
15	
16	COPY package.json bun.lock .npmrc ./
17	COPY prisma ./prisma
18	
19	RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile
20	
21	COPY . .
22	
23	RUN bunx prisma generate
24	
25	# DATABASE_URL is required at build time only to satisfy module-load validation
26	# in routes that import @/lib/db. The value is a placeholder — it is never
27	# used to make a real connection during the build.
28	ARG DATABASE_URL=postgresql://placeholder:placeholder@localhost:5432/placeholder
29	RUN DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL} bun run build
30	
31	# Stage 3: minimal runtime image
32	FROM oven/bun:1-slim AS runner
33	WORKDIR /app
34	
35	ENV NODE_ENV=production
36	ENV PORT=3000
37	ENV HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
38	
39	RUN groupadd --system --gid 1001 nodejs \
40	    && useradd --system --uid 1001 --gid nodejs nextjs
41	
42	# Next.js standalone server: copy directly from .next/standalone/ (Docker
43	# WORKDIR /app produces a flat standalone output, not a nested path).
44	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone/ ./
45	
46	# Static assets referenced by the standalone server
47	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static
48	
49	# Add the following when a public/ directory exists:
50	# COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/public ./public
51	
52	# Worker TypeScript source and shared lib (Bun runs .ts natively)
53	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/worker ./src/worker
54	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/lib ./src/lib
55	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/src/generated ./src/generated
56	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/tsconfig.json ./tsconfig.json
57	
58	# Prisma schema + migrations (used by the migrate Kubernetes Job)
59	COPY --from=build --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/prisma ./prisma
60	
61	# Production node_modules overlaid on the standalone's minimal subset —
62	# provides pg-boss, @prisma/client, and all other worker runtime deps.
63	COPY --from=deps --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules
64	
65	USER nextjs
66	
67	EXPOSE 3000
68	
69	CMD ["bun", "server.js"]
70
